indications_and_usage: Uses Temporarily protects and helps relieve minor skin irritation and itching due to eczema.
warnings: Warnings For external use only. When using this product do not get into eyes. Stop use and ask a doctor if: Conditions worsen Symptoms last more than 7 days or clear up and occur again within a few days. Keep out of reach of children . If swallowed, get medical help or contact a poison control center right away.
